svg.title: Fig. 168(b) — The crossed parallelogram: hyperbolas rolling on hyperbolas
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 168(b), page 183. Section: roulettes.

g.data-text: The long bar BC is fixed to the plane (the pivots B and C in their slides): B and C are the foci of the first hyperbola.
Add the bars BA and CD (equal, the short sides) and AD (equal to BC): a crossed parallelogram.
Extend the short bars BA and CD: they meet at P.
P is on the hyperbola with foci B and C: PB − PC = AB, constant. Both branches are drawn.
An equal hyperbola with foci A and D touches the first at P (PD − PA = AB as well); it rolls on the fixed one as the linkage moves. The dashed pieces continue its branches.
